scientific_integrity: Analytical proof for all sizes and all positive twists; finite computational tests supplement rather than replace the proof. The novelty claim excludes the overlapping antiperiodic endpoint.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted finite first differences only; the zero-flux endpoint is singular, while the antiperiodic endpoint is covered by earlier periodic-cycle results; independent priority and correctness audits remain unperformed.
title: Sharp magnetic-cycle Sobolev embeddings and real–complex flux rigidity
